package.name: franka_meshes
package.description: PickNik mesh assets for Franka robots: convex collision parts for the collision meshes whose own shape is not convex, and OBJ copies of the visual meshes for simulators that cannot read COLLADA. A file keeps franka_description's own directory and changes the file name: a collision part adds a _convex_NN suffix, and a visual mesh becomes _visual.obj.
